string-array.name: novidades
string-array.item: Radio and Podcasts redesigned like the home screen: shelves to the sides, items in a column, the chosen one large with useful details on several lines and the orange dot
“Now playing” always stays at the top, with the cover or logo, the time and how much is left
Radio: favorites (keys 1 to 9 play each one), recent, stations near you, from your country, by genre and from other countries with flags
Podcasts: Continue listening with a bar of how much you heard, new episodes, your podcasts with covers and, inside each one, episodes and “About”
The remote\'s ⏪ ⏩ and ⏯ work anywhere on the podcasts screen; hold OK for more options
A long piece of information, like the title of the last video, now ends in “…” and no longer pushes the others out; “Opened 0 minutes ago” became “Opened now”
Continue: the movie or series name shows without the list tag (“LEG”, “DUB”, “4K”)
Home: with Home Assistant offline, the screen says what happened and that it retries by itself, and Google Home stays at hand
After the screensaver, focus returns to the home screen, not to the top bar
Lighter navigation: the selected icon only starts its animation after the column stops moving
Settings › System › “How this TV is doing”: 7 measurements of the TV, with number and target
Live TV: hold ▲▼ to browse channel names without switching the video; release to switch once
Series: “Skip intro” button; the chosen subtitle is saved for each series
Search that forgives typos (“netflx” finds Netflix) and search inside settings
High contrast, audio description and subtitles for the deaf in Settings
Changed settings show “Undo” for 10 s; Settings › System › “Recent changes”
On the network: a movie folder becomes a catalog with clean titles and “S1 E2”
Panel: one-day invite for guests, backup recovery key and “Move to a new TV”
Stability fixes from a long debugging round

string-array.name: roteiro_perguntas
string-array.item: Opening Radio, do the shelves move sideways with ◀ ▶, does the playing station show at the top with logo and song, and does key 1 play the 1st favorite?
Opening Podcasts, does the half-heard episode show in Continue with the bar, and does OK resume where it stopped?
Listening to a podcast, does ⏪ go back 15 s and ⏩ forward 30 s, with the time at the top following?
